translations.web: and they begged him that they might just touch the fringe of his garment. As many as touched it were made whole.
translations.bsb: and begged Him just to let them touch the fringe of His cloak. And all who touched Him were healed.
translations.kjv: And besought him that they might only touch the hem of his garment: and as many as touched were made perfectly whole.
translations.asv: and they besought him that they might only touch the border of his garment: and as many as touched were made whole.
